description:
Seneca College in Canada, which opened its doors in 1967, started its education life in a renovated factory, the area became Seneca's first campus a year later and became known as the Newnham Campus. In the same year, the Buttonville Campus for Aviation Programs was also activated and in 1971 the King Campus started training within Seneca. The York campuses were opened in 1999 and the Markham campuses in 2005. Apart from these, education continues at small campuses such as Newmarket, Scarborough, Yorkgate and Vaughan.

Seneca College draws attention with the mechatronics project it carries out within the school. With the first Mechatronics Simulation and Demonstration Center of Ontario, established in partnership with Siemens Canada, they are working to draw attention to the technical deficiencies in the production network in Canada and to eliminate these deficiencies.

The school, which has more than 15 departments at the Honors Baccalaureate level, can give its students experiences in different fields. Different departments such as business management, business technology management, international accounting and finance, marketing, informatics, and security are some of the popular areas of study.

Seneca College does not offer graduate-level education like master’s degree. However, the school offers various post-graduate certificate programs that will open the door for students to career and business. The aim of these programs is to increase both academic and practical experience of students by getting education in applied and sector-related departments.

Note: Courses may be requested depending on the department you are applying for. For details, please contact Collab International.
